gaps.valueSet: Cerebrospinal-fluid specimen constraints in source rules 6-8
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no specimen-type evidence or predicate, so general-test branches requiring CSF SNOMED OID 2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1146.1349 are omitted; specimen-specific test-name branches remain where coded
the authoritative source marks HL7 table 0487 unavailable in VSAC

gaps.valueSet: Fungi [Causing Meningitis] (Tests in Cerebrospinal Fluid by Culture and Identification Method)
gaps.reason: the authoritative source lists no codes; source rule 8 retains the coded generic CSF-culture plus fungal-organism branch

gaps.valueSet: Acute-onset qualifier and at-least-two clinical-findings cardinality
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 does not preserve diagnosis/problem qualifiers or support distinct-group cardinality; both are required by source rules 9 and 10, so those rules are omitted entirely rather than allowing isolated symptoms to report

gaps.valueSet: Body Temperature at least 38 C or 100.4 F
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no unit-aware numeric vital-sign comparison predicate; this is one fever alternative within omitted source rules 9 and 10
SEM_V1 has no unit-aware numeric laboratory comparison predicate; this branch occurs in omitted source rule 10

gaps.valueSet: Stiff neck, photophobia, and CSF pleocytosis ICD10CM alternatives
